import json,urllib.request
u='http://127.0.0.1:17410/json/list'
with urllib.request.urlopen(u,timeout=4) as r: xs=json.load(r)
rows=[]
for x in xs:
    if x.get('type')=='page' and 'chatgpt.com' in (x.get('url') or ''):
        rows.append({'id':x.get('id',''),'title':' '.join((x.get('title') or '').split())})
print(json.dumps(rows,ensure_ascii=False))
